articles.title: Monster Hunter Wilds Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Monster Hunter Wilds at IGN: walkthroughs, items, maps, video tips, and strategies
articles.body:
Monster Hunter Wilds is the first of the "sixth generation" of the Monster Hunter series. IGN's Monster Hunter Wilds guide is a thorough guide with a detailed walkthrough, helpful tips, thoughtful how-to guides, and lists of all encyclopedic topics like weapons, armor, monsters, and more.

See a Monster Hunter Wilds Monsters List - this includes links to detailed guides with tips, weaknesses, and material drops for every monster.

Just starting out? Need some guidance? Check these guides out!

Armor is a huge part of Monster Hunter and not only dictates your defense and resistances, but your skills and appearance, too!

All Low Rank Armor in Monster Hunter Wilds

See Armor for an overview of how it works. This should answer all of your questions!

Monster Hunter Wilds Walkthrough and List of Chapters

Our MH Wilds walkthrough includes details on how to prep for the challenges to come, so you know you won't leave camp unprepared!

articles.title: Priority: Tuchanka - Mass Effect 3 Guide - IGN
articles.summary: This page of IGN's Mass Effect 3 wiki guide is all about the Priority: Tuchanka Mission, including how to get through all combat encounters, where to find
articles.body:
This page of IGN's Mass Effect 3 wiki guide is all about the Priority: Tuchanka Mission, including how to get through all combat encounters, where to find all collectibles, and pick the right dialogue choices for your playthrough.

The conclusion of this mission leads directly to " Priority: Citadel 2 ". When this happens, a number of optional quests and interactions will be closed: you will not be able to start and / or complete them, and you will lose out on any credits, XP, War Assets, and Reputation associated with them.

So before starting this Mission, MAKE SURE to complete the following quests and activities:

There's also a number of interactions you can have with various characters that will also be missable:

Docks: Holding Area - Garrus and 2 interactions with Kelly Chambers (3 if you told her to change her identity).

Huerta Memorial Hospital - Dr. Michel and Thane Krios.

Presidium Commons - Joker, EDI, Matriarch Aethyta, Liara, the two businessmen arguing about VIs.

Finally, there are three Citadel Side Missions that you cannot complete until AFTER "Priority: Tuchanka"! Thus you needn't worry about having these hanging around in your Journal:

War Assets: (note that the Krogan and Salarian War Assets are normally mutually exclusive) Turian: Turian 43rd Marine Division (90 TMS) Turian Engineering Corps (110 TMS) Turian Seventh Fleet (90 TMS) Krogan: Clan Urdnot (300 TMS) Krogan Clans (300 TMS) Urnot Wrex / Wreav (30 / 25 TMS) Salarian: Dr. Mordin Solus (25 TMS, if he survived Mass Effect 2) Salarian First Fleet (150 TMS)

Turian: Turian 43rd Marine Division (90 TMS) Turian Engineering Corps (110 TMS) Turian Seventh Fleet (90 TMS)

Krogan: Clan Urdnot (300 TMS) Krogan Clans (300 TMS) Urnot Wrex / Wreav (30 / 25 TMS)

Salarian: Dr. Mordin Solus (25 TMS, if he survived Mass Effect 2) Salarian First Fleet (150 TMS)

Dr. Mordin Solus (25 TMS, if he survived Mass Effect 2)

After completing one of the two initial Tuchanka Side Missions (either " Attican Traverse: Krogan Team " or " Tuchanka: Turian Platoon "), your STG doctor will say that the cure itself is ready, but needs a method of dispersal across the Krogan. Here you can say...

"You've infected them before" for +2 Renegade Points .

As he goes through the list of options, your doctor will realize that they can use The Shroud, which was originally part of a massive array built by the Salarians to clean Tuchanka's atmosphere, then later used to disperse the original Genophage virus. At this, you can say...

"That was devious" for +2 Paragon Points .

"That was clever" for +2 Renegade Points .

Prerequisite: Complete either " Tuchanka: Turian Platoon " or " Attican Traverse: Krogan Team "

Location: Krogan DMZ - Aralakh - Tuchanka

Go to the Krogan DMZ and then to Tuchanka in the Aralakh system. In orbit around Tuchanka, choose the Shroud Facility to begin this mission. As noted above, you'll need to have completed either " Attican Traverse: Krogan Team " or " Tuchanka: Turian Platoon " first, so that your STG Doctor can complete the cure and begin figuring out how to disperse it.

While you're here, you may want to consider getting the following Search and Rescue items from the Krogan DMZ's other systems (although Nith is admittedly optional since it only contains Fuel):

When you select the Mission on Tuchanka itself however, you've got a problem: a Reaper Destroyer has showed up and is using the Shroud to poison Tuchanka's atmosphere instead. There's no way a ground team can distract it long enough for the team to slip in, so Shepard asks Victus for Turian support.

Convince Victus for his support by saying either... "But this is for Palaven" for +2 Paragon Points . "Keep your word" for +2 Renegade Points .

"But this is for Palaven" for +2 Paragon Points .

"Keep your word" for +2 Renegade Points .

Once the plan has been formulated, you can say... "Everyone up for this?" for +2 Paragon Points . "Failure isn't an option" for +2 Renegade Points .

"Everyone up for this?" for +2 Paragon Points .

"Failure isn't an option" for +2 Renegade Points .

As everyone leaves however, you get an urgent call in the Vid Comm Room from the Salarian Dalatrass, who lets you know that the Shroud was tampered with years ago to prevent any cure from being effective. Plainly she doesn't believe the Krogan will be co-operative after you cure the Genophage: at this, you can say...

"Yes, this could work" for +2 Paragon Points .

"No, krogan aren't peaceful" for +2 Renegade Points .

Either way, she offers you significant Salarian support in exchange for ensuring the cure won't work.

Squad Tactics: You'll be facing a lot of armored enemies, so Garrus and James make good choices.

You'll be facing a lot of armored enemies, so Garrus and James make good choices.

Unique Dialogue: For the most unique dialogue, pick Liara and Garrus . If Garrus isn't available, pick EDI . Liara and Javik is another good pair.

For the most unique dialogue, pick Liara and Garrus .

Shepard's Loadout: Bring a Shotgun for the initial Husk fight. The Scorpion Heavy Pistol can be very useful in taking out the Brutes and Ravagers .

Bring a Shotgun for the initial Husk fight.

The Scorpion Heavy Pistol can be very useful in taking out the Brutes and Ravagers .

As you head towards the Hollows, Shepard is oddly quiet, and Eve will ask if there's something on your mind. Here you can pick either...

"[Reveal Shroud sabotage]" for +2 Paragon Points .

"[Say nothing for now.]" for +2 Renegade Points .

Unfortunately even if you decide to reveal the sabotage, Shepard has no time to actually spit it out, as you get attacked on the way: the Hollows have been overrun.

As soon as you touch down you will face an onslaught of Husks. The best way to handle them is to strafe around the area with a Shotgun, but the arena is open enough for maneuvers around the Husks. Use your Squad powers when you get trapped, but otherwise the shotgun should be all you need.

When the Husks are all dead, you'll get into a lengthy cutscene with dialogue choices. From the outset, pick "What clan are you?" on the left to make sure you can get as many Morality Points as possible here. The exact names of the options will vary depending on who the Krogan Leader is:

"The salarian is with me" OR "He's saving your people", "Count me in", "The krogan have earned it OR "Leave it in the past" ( +6 Paragon Points total).

"Fall in line", "Everyone had better help", "Expansion could be a problem" OR "I'd want revenge, too" ( +6 Renegade Points total).

After this you'll then be in a Tomkah on the way to the Shroud. Yet again Eve will notice Shepard and ask if they want to say something. This decision will affect the tone of this Mission's climactic scene:

Pick "[Reveal Shroud sabotage]" to allow your STG doctor to adjust the cure for +15 Paragon Points . If you destroyed Maelon's data in Mass Effect 2, then Wrex will take this honesty as an apology, which he accepts.

If you destroyed Maelon's data in Mass Effect 2, then Wrex will take this honesty as an apology, which he accepts.

Pick "[Say nothing for now]" to withhold the sabotage from your STG doctor for +2 Renegade Points .

Suddenly the Tomkah convoy stops, and you hop out to investigate. Before you do that however, you should sweep the area for a bevy of loot:

Med Kit - Immediately to your left from your starting position, in the middle of the clearing.

Graal Spike Thrower - This Shotgun is leaning up against the railing at the edge of the area, directly in front of you after picking up the Med Kit above.

Shotgun Smart Choke - Turn around and head back to your starting position, then head left (or counter-clockwise) along the Tomkah wheels. The first item is this mod, by the kneeling Krogan working on the Tomkah.

Pistol Magazine Upgrade - Found further to the left, between the wheels of another Tomkah.

Once you've picked everything up, talk to the Krogan Scout, and things will escalate where Shepard is forced to order Eve be moved immediately. This strands Shepard behind on the highway, and you'll have to figure out an alternate route. Follow the Mission Maker to the doorway across the gap and head into the ancient catacombs.

You'll now find yourself in the dark catacombs. This area is pitch black and a bit of a maze, but luckily Shepard has a torch and you have us. You may be bewildered by the many twists and turns, but in reality the various paths lead to the same place. There are some collectibles down here, which we'll direct you to, starting with dropping down the end of the first, large staircase.

Ancient Krogan Artifact #1 - 8,500 Credits. After dropping off the end of the first large staircase at the beginning of the catacombs, turn left on the spot to see a doorway. Head through here and drop down the ledge, then head directly forward through another doorway into a room with a column in the middle. On the right-hand wall will be this as a wall painting.

Ancient Krogan Artifact #2 - 8,500 Credits. Backtrack to the previous room and turn left to find another doorway on the left-hand wall, which has you drop into small trench in the ground: here Eve will talk about Kalros, the mother of all Thresher Maws. Head left from here and you'll find this painting of Kalros directly ahead.

Ancient Krogan Artifact #3 - 8,500 Credits. From Artifact #2, continue through this area in an effective U-Turn, and the only way forwards will be a doorway on your left into a hallway. Check the right-hand wall of this hallway for the third and final wall painting, depicting Krogan riding war beasts.

Soon you will find a Ravager corpse at the bottom of the stairs leading out. This scene will have alternate dialogue if you haven't yet completed " Attican Traverse: Krogan Team ". Continue up the stairs and you'll eventually make your way up to the surface again.

As you continue forwards a few meteoric barrages will drop Ravagers and Cannibals. The Ravagers have tough Shields and fire highly damaging shots like rocket launchers. If you are hit by their missiles your own shield will evaporate fast. Stay far away and behind cover to deal with them. You can pretty much ignore the Cannibals and focus on the Ravagers for now. If you stick Ravagers with Viper shots or use Armor Piercing Rounds they go down easy.

Jump across the gap in the bridge ahead. In the next area you encounter a Brute, but you can handle it much better if you keep your distance. Hang far back on the bridge and snipe the Cannibals. Inch forward until the Brute appears and, while it's still ambling out of the doorway ahead, pummel it with everything you've got. Hopefully it won't get a chance to go on the offensive, but if it does remember that you can tap the Sprint button to dodge roll out of the way.

You will eventually come to a large area with a doorway flanked by large Krogan statues. Between these pour several Cannibals and a pair of Ravagers. Run to the small, raised area and take cover behind the low wall facing the Ravagers and fire at them. The Cannibals should ignore you, but the Husks won't! Take out the Cannibals quickly so you can run around and hit the Husks with your Shotgun.

Now cross the bridge. A View Prompt will help you see the Krogan Leader's Tomkah being chased by Kalros and take out a tiny chunk of the bridge. Kalros destroying the bridge shouldn't stop you: you can cross a narrow gap on the right-hand side and leap over it.

Begin crossing the large plaza with the Krogan statues and then you'll come up against more Cannibals and Husks. This time a trio of Marauders join them from the far side. Just be sure to have your Shotgun ready for the Husk onslaught while you work the Marauders Shields down. Once you're ready, look for collectibles in the area.

SMG Scope - Before leaving the area with the first Marauders of the level, search the left-hand side of the arena for this Weapon Mod. It'll be near the stairs connecting it to the second area.

Assault Rifle Extended Barrel - As you leave the arena with the Marauders you climb down and then up two sets of stairs. Head left and up some more stairs to find this Weapon Mod in the corner.

When you drop down the gap on the right-hand side of the stairs you'll initiate a cutscene that moves you to the next area.

The next cutscene will detail the plan to get the Reaper Destroyer out of the way: by using a pair of Maw Hammers to summon Kalros and keep the Destroyer occupied. Here you have two pairs of options for Morality Points:

"What about the risks?" and "Be safe" ( +2 Paragon Points total).

"We've done crazier things" and "Let's get it done ( +2 Renegade Points total).

Additionally, if Wrex is the Krogan Leader and you either spared Maelon's data in Mass Effect 2 or are back on good terms with Wrex after destroying it, you'll get an exclusive Paragon Interrupt that you can pull for +5 Paragon Points .

After the cutscene concludes, take cover and fight off more Cannibals. You shouldn't find these guys too surprising to deal with by now. Once they're all dead, head for the stairs on the left-hand side of the area.

M-5 Phalanx - Climb the stairs after killing the Cannibals, then turn left to find this pistol.

After getting the pistol, head to the far end and leap over the gap. The Reaper above has noticed you, but luckily the Turian ships return to the fight to keep it distracted for you. Sprint as fast as you can across the rubble to the Maw Hammers, and the last fight of the level.

The goal here is to activate two spots, one up some stairs on the right and one just across from it on the left. Each hammer has a Reaper leg guarding it that can crush you, but that's the least of your worries: Brutes will spawn infinitely to hamper your progress (but luckily they only spawn in two at a time, not counting the two that are initially there).

That said, this section ends once you activate the Maw Hammers, so if you're fast and clever, you can actually just Sprint straight to one, activate the Maw Hammer, then rush across to the opposite side of the battlefield and hit the second one. This tactic is much easier if you are an Infiltrator with Tactical Cloak , since you can slip past the Brutes undetected. You still need to pause to avoid the Reaper legs guarding each Hammer either way, however.

Hit both of the Maw Hammers, and Kalros will show up and destroy the Reaper, however the Shroud takes a big blow in the ensuing fight. With the Destroyer destroyed, Shepard heads into the Shroud to see how their STG Doctor is doing.

After the Hammers are activated you will be privy to an important dialogue scene. There are many different outcomes that are made possible thanks to the choices you've made in all the games in the Trilogy before this point.

The first outcome point occurs when Shepard first enters the room, concerning the fate of Eve. It occurs via exposition from the STG Doctor when Shepard first enters the room:

If you saved Maelon's research data in Mass Effect 2, then Eve will have lived through the procedure.

If you destroyed Maelon's research data in Mass Effect 2, then Eve will have died while you were fighting the Reaper. Starting Mass Effect 3 without importing a Mass Effect 2 Profile will always give this result, even if you used the Genesis 2 DLC comic.

What happens next depends on whether you decided to reveal the Shroud's sabotage to your STG Doctor, Eve and the Krogan leader back in the Tomkah convoy:

If you warned Eve and the Krogan Leader about the Shroud Sabotage back in the Tomkah convoy, then when Shepard arrives your STG Doctor will have countered it already. Their ascent up the elevator is automatic, meaning they'll always sacrifice their life to cure the Genophage.

If Mordin is your STG Doctor, you can pull a Paragon Interrupt as he heads into the elevator. While it doesn't dissuade him from his task, it allows you to part ways by saying either...

You'll also get +15 Reputation for curing the Genophage.

If you DIDN'T reveal the Shroud sabotage to Eve and the Krogan Leader back in the Tomkah convoy, then your STG Doctor will notice something is wrong, opening up the possibility to stop them from dispersing the Genophage cure. Here are your options:

Pick "[Explain sabotage]" to justify your reasons for +2 Paragon Points , letting you choose either... "I was wrong" for +2 Paragon Points . "I need the salarians" for +2 Renegade Points .

"I need the salarians" for +2 Renegade Points .

Pick "[Delay him]" to try and obstruct the STG Doctor for +2 Renegade Points .

If you picked either "[Delay him]" or "I need the salarians" as described above, you'll now have several options to choose from:

Pick "I'm not stopping you" / "I was wrong. Go ahead" to let the STG Doctor ascend in the elevator, sacrificing their life to cure the Genophage for +15 Reputation .

Pick "I'll stop you if I have to" to try and stop your STG Doctor with a Renegade Interrupt: Pulling the Renegade Interrupt shoots your STG Doctor dead for +15 Renegade Points . Ignoring the Renegade Interrupt lets them go up the elevator, sacrificing their life to cure the Genophage, getting you +15 Reputation .

Pulling the Renegade Interrupt shoots your STG Doctor dead for +15 Renegade Points .

Ignoring the Renegade Interrupt lets them go up the elevator, sacrificing their life to cure the Genophage, getting you +15 Reputation .

If Wrex is dead and Eve died while your STG Doctor synthesized the Genophage cure, you also have two Persuasion options to choose from: Pick the "Now isn't the time" Charm to convince the STG Doctor to walk away with their life for +15 Paragon Points . Pick the "Why?" Intimidate to convince the STG Doctor to walk away with their life for +15 Renegade Points .

Pick the "Now isn't the time" Charm to convince the STG Doctor to walk away with their life for +15 Paragon Points .

Pick the "Why?" Intimidate to convince the STG Doctor to walk away with their life for +15 Renegade Points .

Once you've made your choices, you'll then see the Shroud disperse the particles shortly before collapsing, and then you'll reconvene with the Krogan Leader in the Hollows. If Eve died, this scene will her funeral.

There are a wide variety of potential options here given the outcome of the Shroud finale, but rest assured that the upper-right option will give +2 Paragon Points , and the lower-right option will give +2 Renegade Points .

You'll then reconvene with Admiral Hackett over your decisions, and at last seal the deal with Primarch Victus for Turian support when the time comes to retake Earth. Garrus will then insist Shepard get some rest, despite their objections. You'll now be in another dream sequence where you chase after the boy, this time with inky black figures in the park and the voices of the dead echoing through the air. Shepard will then wake up and have a small chat with Liara over the fallen, then head to the Vid Comm room.

This time it's a conversation with the Salarian Councillor. You'll again have several potential options here, but as in The Hollows, the upper-right one will always give +2 Paragon Points , and the bottom-right one +2 Renegade Points . Either way you'll pick up a new Mission: " Priority: The Citadel 2 ".

Now you can explore the Normandy again to hear everyone's responses to the aftermath of Tuchanka.

CIC - Talk to Hackett on the Vid Comm, Traynor to get " N7: Cerberus Fighter Base ", and Joker / Garrus on the Bridge for +2 Reputation . If you saved Zhu's Hope on Feros in Mass Effect 1, you'll have an email that, once read, will give you the Zhu's Hope Colonists War Asset, worth 30 TMS.

If you saved Zhu's Hope on Feros in Mass Effect 1, you'll have an email that, once read, will give you the Zhu's Hope Colonists War Asset, worth 30 TMS.

Crew Deck - Talk to Liara, as well as EDI in the AI Core.

Engineering - Talk to Javik for +2 Reputation , and Engineer Adams to complete " Citadel: GX12 Thermal Pipe ". If Gabby and Ken are both present, you'll get Optimized Eezo Capacitors worth 15 TMS! You can also talk to Diana Allers for an interview. This will give +5 Reputation , and you can add +5 TMS to either the Krogan Clans (Charm) or Turian Seventh Fleet (Intimidate).

You can also talk to Diana Allers for an interview. This will give +5 Reputation , and you can add +5 TMS to either the Krogan Clans (Charm) or Turian Seventh Fleet (Intimidate).

You may notice in the Requisitions Terminal that the M-25 Hornet is now for sale from Batarian State Arms. We advise against buying it at this time, because you can pick it up for free in an upcoming Mission.

articles.title: Mountain of Imprisonment Sha-Chi Amber Shard Locations - Phantom Blade Zero Guide - IGN
articles.summary: You'll find only a few Sha-Chi Amber Fragments in the Mountain of Imprisonment in Phantom Blade Zero. This is an optional location that you can enter from
articles.body:
You'll find only a few Sha-Chi Amber Fragments in the Mountain of Imprisonment in Phantom Blade Zero . This is an optional location that you can enter from Meigu Lake, and only after you have completed the Illusory Pipa side quest. Keep reading this guide to find the locations of the four Sha-Chi Amber Shards in Mountain of Imprisonment.

All Mountain of Imprisonment Sha-Chi Amber Shards

There are four Sha-Chi Amber Fragments in Mountain of Imprisonment. Check the map above for their general location and the rest of the guide for the individual spots.

Mountain of Imprisonment Sha-Chi Amber Fragment 1

From the Commander’s Platform , where you fought Commander Bi, go north and start climbing the mountain. You’ll see a passage with red shrines : go through it.

Keep going up until you find a small area with enemies. Before the path that you need to follow, you’ll see a tower with an archer . Climb the tower's ladder, defeat the archer, and open the purple chest.

Mountain of Imprisonment Sha-Chi Amber Fragment 2

This is dropped by Kui Yanyan, The Deranged — the boss that you’ll fight after the Shrine Outer Gate.

Mountain of Imprisonment Sha-Chi Amber Fragment 3

In the Shrine Outer Gate , you might have noticed two locked doors — one in front of the bell, the other to the left. The shard is past the left door; to open it, you'll need to activate the lift in the lower area, Cavern Passage, where you can find Liu Yi , the NPC from the Hero's Lament side tale.

To activate the lift, you need the Missing Lift Crank , which is dropped by Kui Yanyan, The Deranged . Once you have it, insert the crank, use the lift, and interact with the corpse in the small room — it has the shard.

Mountain of Imprisonment Sha-Chi Amber Fragment 4

articles.title: How to Feed Meringuins Their Favorite Food - Disney Dreamlight Valley Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Meringuins are one of the new new critters to befriend in Disney Dreamlight Valley's Keepsake Sea expansion. There are five different variants of these
articles.body:
Meringuins are one of the new new critters to befriend in Disney Dreamlight Valley 's Keepsake Sea expansion . There are five different variants of these creatures, and each of these appear at different times per day. You'll have to find them to feed them, which is how you bring them on as your companion animal. Meringuins have to be fed their Liked or Favorite foods just once to bring on as a companion.

This guide will cover everything you need to know about Meringuins, how to approach them, what to feed them, and their schedule .

TL;DR ~ All Meringuin Details You Need to Know

Meringuin's Favorite Foods: Candy Pebbles

Number of Feeds to Unlock as Companion: Two

Feeding Rewards: Liked Food Reward: Dream Shard, Memory Shard Favorite Food Reward: Dream Shard, Memory Shard, Motif Bag

Liked Food Reward: Dream Shard, Memory Shard

Favorite Food Reward: Dream Shard, Memory Shard, Motif Bag

Meringuin Schedules: Salted Licorice Meringuin: All Day, Every Day Raspberry Sherbert Meringuin: Every Day, Between 12PM to 12AM Cherry Soda Meringuin: Every Day - Between 12AM to 12PM Frosted Blueberry Meringuin: Sunday, Wednesday, Saturday - Between 12PM to 12AM Orange Cream Meringuin: Wednesday, Saturday, and Sunday - Between 12AM to 12PM

Salted Licorice Meringuin: All Day, Every Day

Raspberry Sherbert Meringuin: Every Day, Between 12PM to 12AM

Cherry Soda Meringuin: Every Day - Between 12AM to 12PM

Frosted Blueberry Meringuin: Sunday, Wednesday, Saturday - Between 12PM to 12AM

Orange Cream Meringuin: Wednesday, Saturday, and Sunday - Between 12AM to 12PM

How to Feed Meringuins Their Favorite Foods

Time To Unlock As Companion: One feeding

If you feed a Meringuin its Liked foods, which are any Fruits , you'll receive a Dream Shard and a Memory Shard. If you feed a Meringuin its Favorite food, Lychee , you'll receive a Dream Shard, Memory Shard, and Motif Bag.

articles.title: I Play Rocky - Official ‘Training’ Clip - IGN
articles.summary: Here's a look at the ‘Training’ Clip for I Play Rocky, a dramatic biopic film distributed by Amazon MGM Studios. Get a behind-the-scenes look at the seminal scene in I Play Rocky, in select theaters now and everywhere on November 20.The film is an electrifying true story about an unknown actor with an unshakable belief that he wasn’t just meant to write Rocky—he was meant to be Rocky Balboa. Told “no” at every turn, Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds. The result is the ultimate underdog story behind the ultimate underdog movie.I Play Rocky stars Anthony Ippolito, Matt Dillon, AnnaSophia Robb, P.J. Byrne, Toby Kebbell, Tracy Letts, Jay Duplass, Stephan James, Kiki Seto, Robert Morgan, Saul Stein, Trevor St. John, Erik Palladino, and Rob Demery. The film is directed by Peter Farrelly and produced by Toby Emmerich, Christian Baha, and Peter Farrelly.I Play Rocky is in select theaters now and everywhere on November 20.

articles.title: I Play Rocky - Official ‘Meeting Carl Weathers’ Clip - IGN

articles.title: GTA 6 Shatters Streaming Records Before It Even Launches Globally
articles.summary: GTA 6 is already breaking records, despite not having even been out for a full day yet.
articles.body:
GTA 6 is already breaking records, despite not having even been out for a full day yet.

According to StreamCharts, GTA 6 shattered livestreaming viewership records following its release in New Zealand. Streamers began grinding the game at the earliest hours of the morning here in the United States thanks to handy loopholes on Xbox, allowing them to get a head start on things. As of 12:30 UTC today, the game crossed 6.38 million concurrent viewers across Twitch, YouTube, and Kick. This is nearly four times the previous record holder, which was Valorant's closed beta.

Twitch also provided first details about the game's performance using its own internal data to IGN.

GTA 6 smashed the Valorant on Twitch record, which stood at 1.7 million concurrent viewers in 2020.

On Twitch, GTA 6 is at tens of millions of hours watched, just a couple hours in. The equivalent of more than 1,500 years of nonstop viewing.

The equivalent of more than 1,500 years of nonstop viewing.

Top GTA Streamer Rubius reached 311k live viewers for GTAVI within an hour of starting his broadcast.

GTA 6 in North America is technically not available to play yet but the streamer has already seen: Twitch viewership is up 111% compared with this time last week. At one point early this morning Twitch had more than 3.3 million live viewers in the GTA 6 category.

Twitch viewership is up 111% compared with this time last week.

At one point early this morning Twitch had more than 3.3 million live viewers in the GTA 6 category.

Twitch recently revealed to IGN that GTA 5 has accumulated 9 billion hours watched over the course of its entire lifetime, making it an absolute juggernaut for the platform. It's one of the most-watched games and it's likely that GTA 6 will retain get at least one or two more big boosts in viewership. The game is rumored to come to PC early next year and its online mode is also expected sometime in 2027, both of which will likely be events in their own rights.

IGN recently spoke with a number of content creators about how they're planning to handle GTA 6 and how long they think this game will remain relevant. Although some streamers believe this game will only be lucrative for a couple of weeks, others think there's potential for it to be mined for months and years to come.

IGN gave the game a 10/10 , noting that the game is simply unmatched in its depth, quality, and detail. The game is currently the highest-rated game in history on Metacritic with an unprecedented 99 average score.

"Exquisitely detailed, endlessly ripe for experimentation, and uncompromisingly engineered, Grand Theft Auto 6 is the single most impressive video game I have ever played," reads an excerpt from our review.

For more GTA 6, check out our breakdown of how long the game can be depending on how you play, how it performs on Xbox Series S , and much, much more.

Cade Onder is a freelancer for IGN's news team. He covers all things entertainment, including gaming, film, and more. You can find him on Twitter @Cade_Onder.

articles.title: The Wachowskis Move to Reclaim The Matrix Rights From Skydance
articles.summary: The future of The Matrix franchise is suddenly in doubt, as Lilly and Lana Wachowski move to reclaim the copyright to the iconic sci-fi franchise from Warner Bros.
articles.body:
The future of The Matrix franchise is looking increasingly murky. According to The Puck Report , Lana and Lilly Wachowski have formally notified Warner Bros. of their move to reclaim the copyright to the iconic sci-fi franchise.

If successful, the Wachowskis would regain the rights to the series on the 30th anniversary of the original film's release in 2029. This move comes as the studio is developing a fifth The Matrix movie , with Drew Goddard attached to write and direct and Lana Wachowski herself executive producing. That project may give the Wachowskis extra leverage in their negotiations with Warners.

The Matrix Movies in (Chronological) Order

Will this derail development on The Matrix 5? Not necessarily. The site also notes that WB's new parent company Skydance seems confident in its ability to negotiate a new deal, building on previous successes renegotiating the copyright for The Godfather and acquiring The Terminator rights in 2011. The Puck Report also alludes to a potential legal hurdle on the Wachowskis' side, as it could be argued that the original The Matrix screenplay was part of a work-for-hire arrangement with Warner Bros. back in the '90s.

All of this may suggest that the more likely outcome is that the Wachowskis negotiate a new, more lucrative deal and Skydance retains the rights to The Matrix for the foreseeable future. Despite Lilly Wachowski publicly distancing herself from the property , The Puck Report writes, "From what I hear, the sisters have been encouraging of the newest sequel and have even increased their involvement lately."

Little is currently known about The Matrix 5 beyond Goddard's involvement. There's currently no release date, nor is it clear whether series stars Keanu Reeves and Carrie-Anne Moss will return or if the focus will shift to a new cast of cyberpunk martial artists. But the studio seems to have high hopes for the sequel, despite its predecessor, 2021's The Matrix Resurrections, proving to be a box office dud. It certainly didn't help that the film debuted during the height of the COVID-19 pandemic and premiered on HBO Max the same day as it did in theaters, prompting a lawsuit from Village Roadshow .

Jesse is a mild-mannered staff writer for IGN. Allow him to lend a machete to your intellectual thicket by following @jschedeen on BlueSky .

articles.title: Burger King’s Chocolate Whopper Prank Is Being Turned Into a Real Burger
articles.body:
In 2018, Burger King posted a Chocolate Whopper as an April Fool’s Joke. Nearly a decade later, the decadent burger is actually coming to life.

The Chocolate Whopper is coming to Burger King Korea’s new flagship restaurant, the Flameground, which recently launched its first location in Seoul. Flameground somehow turns Burger King food into a luxurious dining experience, showcasing the fast-food chain’s most experimental creations.

Burger King Korea accounts have shared AI-generated renderings of the Chocolate Whopper’s concept: layers of sauces and brownie patties encased in a chocolate fudge bun. We'll have to wait until the burger launches on November 19 to see what it actually looks and tastes like.

Unfortunately, the Chocolate Whopper is getting an extremely limited rollout. The burger isn’t even coming to general Burger King Korea locations, and is instead entirely restricted to the single Flameground restaurant, which requires a reservation.

The generated rendering is jam-packed, to say the least. Each burger is handmade, and orders are restricted to one per person with daily quantity limits. The Chocolate Whopper will also only be available as a dine-in experience, no take-out allowed, so Burger King is really trying to stop you from sharing.

Ahead of the launch, Burger King also reshared the original April Fool's prank video. The original prank featured some candied tomatoes the real version understandably skips out on.

Burger King Korea launched its first Flameground restaurant this past September. The Seongsu location currently offers three signature burgers: the K-Cube Galbi, the Philly Cheese Steak, and the Memphis BBQ. These are priced between ₩12,900 and ₩13,900, equivalent to around $10 USD. The restaurant has yet to announce pricing for the Chocolate Whopper.

The entire Burger King franchise has taken to wacky marketing, though most of the chain’s big promotions stick to licensed collaborations. For example, Burger King Italy just launched a Magic: The Gathering meal with an exclusive deck box everyone has been trying to get their hands on. Surprisingly, the fast-food chain has yet to announce any new food items inspired by GTA 6 , which features the parody restaurant Burger Shot.

Blythe (she/her) is an Audience Development Coordinator at IGN who spends way too much time in character customization screens and tracking down collectibles.

articles.title: A GTA 6 Location Was Teased by Rockstar All the Way Back in 2021 — And What's Inside Was Worth the Wait
articles.summary: In 2021, Rockstar fans believed that a GTA 6 screenshot was snuck into the GTA trilogy collection, but there's more to this theory than meets the eye.
articles.body:
SPOILER WARNING: This article features details on a GTA 6 Easter egg. Although it won't ruin the game's story or anything like that, we recognize some people want to organically discover and find interesting things on their own. You've been warned!

In 2021, Rockstar Games released the somewhat controversial remastered collection of the PS2 era GTA titles. It was... a mess, to say the least. However, one notable thing came from that collection, but fans weren't sure if it actually meant anything. There was a picture of a house in this new version of GTA: San Andreas that wasn't there in the original game, and it didn't look like a location from any other GTA game. Fans theorized this was actually our first look at GTA 6 ... and it turns out, they were right!

The house is real. It's located in Leonard County, in the suburb of Belville (shoutout Jared from the GTA mapping community for discovering this). However, that's just the tip of the iceberg. If you approach the house's garage, you can actually break in. Upon entry, it becomes clear this is a lair for some kind of conspiracy theorist. These aren't just ordinary in-universe ramblings — they're from someone who believes they are in a video game.

All credit goes to Jared from the GTA VI Mapping server. The house is located in Belville. ( — GTA Wiki (@GTAWikiOfficial) November 18, 2026

All credit goes to Jared from the GTA VI Mapping server. The house is located in Belville. (

Various notes and writings on the wall point out that they can't leave Lenoida at all. They tried to purchase a ticket to Los Santos and couldn't, nor could they drive out of the state, and instead are planning to get a boat to try and escape. They also noted that there are an extraordinary amount of doppelgangers in reference to NPCs, that there is nothing behind closed doors, their own neighbors can't enter their homes, and that people phase through walls or "glitch." There's also a graph that shows a comically large spike in violent crime and a bunch of 6s written all over the place, likely poking fun at some of the people who drove themselves mad theorizing about this very game.

Perhaps one of the most notable bits is that this conspiracy theorist has determined two people, who go by "J" (Jason) and "L" (Lucia), are immune to whatever problems they are experiencing, suggesting they have freedom and autonomy. Ironically, they may have the least amount of autonomy, though, since they are controlled by the player, but they respawn, are largely free of longterm legal consequences, and can cause tons of mayhem, so they're less restricted than NPCs.

It's a very silly Easter egg, and one that leans into the absurdity of the GTA community in many ways. It's unclear whether this house was always meant to be like this, or if someone at the studio decided to have some fun with it after they saw how mad it drove fans. Either way, it gave me a good chuckle.

In related news, GTA 6 is already shattering all kinds of records despite not being out globally. The game is driving tons of traffic to Twitch, YouTube, and Kick, with millions of people just watching the game. As for its critical reception, GTA 6 got a 10/10 from IGN and its critical praise has been echoed across the industry. In addition to being nominated for Game of the Year , GTA 6 is currently tied with The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time as the highest rated game of all-time on Metacritic . While its position could change as more reviews trickle in over the next few weeks, it's clear this game is a gargantuan hit (though that likely isn't surprising).

Cade Onder is a freelancer for IGN's news team. He covers all things entertainment, including gaming, film, and more. You can find him on Twitter @Cade_Onder.

articles.title: 43 Army Members Reenlisted in Exchange for Paid Time Off to Play GTA 6
articles.summary: If you’ve been following the GTA 6 hype train, you’ll probably remember the time that an army battalion went viral for offering service members four days of paid time off to play Rockstar's highly-anticipated game if they reenlisted.
articles.body:
If you’ve been following the GTA 6 hype train, you’ll probably remember the time that an army battalion went viral for offering service members four days of paid time off to play Rockstar's highly-anticipated game if they reenlisted.

The news became a hot topic after a flyer advertising the paid leave was first shared online back in August. Now that GTA 6 is almost upon us (or, in some regions, already out ), we’ve finally gotten an update on how many soldiers actually took up the battalion's offer.

The flyer, dated July 28, concerned the 9th Engineer Battalion in Fort Stewart, Georgia, and promised a “special reenlistment incentive” by giving eligible service members four days off to play the game from November 20 - 23, 2026. This was done specifically to “coincide with the highly anticipated release of the video game Grand Theft Auto VI,” with the goal of “promoting retention, boosting morale, and rewarding the continued dedication of the Soldiers within the 9th Brigade Engineer Battalion.”

Three months later, military-focused news outlet Task and Purpose has shared a follow-up on this incentive, confirming that 43 members of the battalion took up the offer. Two of these soldiers spoke with the platform — one being combat engineer Sgt. Jamire Smith, who says he signed up for the GTA 6-specific PTO and an additional six more years in the armed forces. However, this extra time came with a nice $60,000 bonus, owed to his special training learning how to drive heavy breaching vehicles.

“I’m all campaign. I’m all about the heist. I think I have a good 24 hours to waste on it,” he told the outlet. “I was actually in the process of getting out, I was towards my final stages of getting out … but my company and the battalion helped me navigate through that and they showed me that there’s still a need for me, and that I am still a clear and value asset to the team, and so that’s really what drove me to say ‘let’s keep going, let’s keep driving.’ Maybe be a lifer in this, since I already made it my career.”

Task and Purpose even got in touch with the person responsible for coming up with the campaign, Staff Sgt. Brittany Wolfer, a career counselor who explained why she chose to use the game as an eye-catching way to get soldiers to stay in the service.

“I brought it to my battalion commander and he’s a little bit older, but he did play GTA 2 at some point, so he was like, ‘Yeah I’m down for it,’” Wolfer explained. “I came into [the unit], there hadn’t been a counselor for about eight months, so there [were] a lot of gaps and things that were falling through, because the soldiers didn’t have that presence within the formation. This was just a way to grab people’s attention and kind of be like, ‘Hey, here I am. I’m the person you’re gonna come talk to,’ and [it] kind of snowballed from there.”

Wolfer made it clear that she knows the GTA 6-focused PTO dates won’t be a “deciding factor” in someone’s decision to reenlist, but said the idea was a way to “bridge that gap” between soldiers and their senior command “to where that lower soldier still knows that their battalion commander or their senior leadership cares about them and sees what they’re interested in. And that’s kind of what this was for.”

GTA 6 releases for players in the United States at 12am ET / 9pm PT. Despite not even being officially out yet, it has already scored eight nominations at the 2026 Game Awards , and is one of the highest-rated games in Metacritic history . You can check out our review for the game right here on IGN, which we scored a glowing 10 out of 10.

Virginia (she/her) is IGN’s News Editor. With ten years of experience reporting on games and entertainment, she’s got a storied background in the fighting game community, influencer news, and viral online trends. Find her on Twitter at @TheeMissGlaze .
